title: A Loop That Adds

snapshots.note: score is created and set to 0.
i is created and set to 0. The loop checks i < 3.
Condition is true, so the loop body runs.
i++ runs. i becomes 1. Condition is checked again.

question.prompt: After the next pass through the loop body, what will score be?

revealSnapshot.note: score = score + 2 runs again. score becomes 4.
